source.name: Football Shirt Culture: South Korea 2026 Nike Home Kit
source.quote: The Korea FA crest is positioned on the chest with “KOREA” beneath, alongside a Nike Swoosh in a gold tone
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The FSC launch article describes the shirt's markings as the KFA crest with 'KOREA' beneath, a gold Nike Swoosh and a small Authentic Licensed Nike patch near the hem, worn 'with black shorts and red socks'; it names no commercial sponsor on any placement.

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: Nike's 2026 home shirt for the South Korea national team (Global Red with a tonal White Tiger graphic, black sleeve cuffs) carries only the KFA crest with 'KOREA' beneath, a gold Nike Swoosh and an Authentic Licensed Nike patch near the hem, worn with black shorts and red socks (Football Shirt Culture's launch description).
